assets.label: 组件视觉参考板
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: visual reference board for Arena UI, a premium dark fantasy game web component library. Generate a meticulously art-directed 1536x1024 landscape UI component specimen board on nearly black #0e1116. Modular neatly aligned grid with generous spacing, beautifully crafted thin metallic line work, warm gold #f2b632 primary action, cyan #3ec7e0 selection, blue-gray #171c24 surfaces, sharp 2px-radius corners. Top understated typography reads 'ARENA UI' and 'COMPONENT COLLECTION'. Include a top left group of gold, dark outlined secondary, and red outlined danger action buttons labeled 'BATTLE', 'EQUIP', 'DISMANTLE'; three HP red, MP cyan and XP gold progress bars with numerical labels; a tasteful dark character statistics panel; eight fantasy inventory cells with sword, shield, violet ring, red potion, axe, helmet, scroll and cyan crystal; a gold-accented modal with 'READY TO BATTLE?' and two action buttons; a tab navigation strip; a few small status badges and control switches. Flat front-facing interface layout, typography crisp and minimal, no perspective, no device, no desk, no watermarks. This is a visual exploration image, all important labels must look clean and restrained.

assets.label: 装备图集
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game inventory icon atlas. Generate one landscape 1536x1024 image with EXACTLY 4 columns and 2 rows of equal cells, no gutters, every object centered and fully contained with 20% margin in its own cell. Flat opaque uniform background #171c24 across whole sheet. Row1 left to right: elegant silver longsword with gold guard, reinforced silver and dark steel shield with cyan gemstone, delicate gold ring with violet gemstone, small round glass potion flask with red liquid. Row2 left to right: double headed dark iron battle axe, steel hornless knight helmet, rolled aged parchment scroll with gold seal, cluster of glowing cyan crystals. Hand painted 3D fantasy inventory assets, realistic metal highlights, sculptural depth, coherent top-left lighting and consistent scale. Rich detail clearly readable at small size. No UI frames, borders, labels, numbers, text, characters, watermarks. Every object isolated inside exactly its own 4-by-2 grid cell. Do not let objects overlap cells.

assets.label: 玩法入口扩展图集
assets.prompt: Arena UI dark fantasy game component library. Premium coherent painterly 3D game art, crisp silhouettes, detailed steel and leather, controlled top-left lighting. Palette charcoal #0e1116 and #171c24, silver #9aa6b8, gold #f2b632 for rewards and action, cyan #3ec7e0 for energy and selection. Red only for health or damage, green only for healing, violet only for epic rarity. No text, letters, numbers, UI borders, logos or watermark. Create a landscape 1536x1024 atlas with exactly 4 columns and 2 rows of equally sized cells, no gutters or visible grid. Flat opaque #171c24 throughout. Center one complete object in each cell with 20 percent margin, consistent scale and no effects crossing cell boundaries. Eight sculptural miniature game mode objects, each a clearly readable menu icon. Row one left to right: a sturdy charcoal leather training dummy on a small iron stand, a compact dark wood expedition airship with silver fins and a tiny gold prow, a narrow stepped dark stone challenge tower with a cyan energy beacon, a miniature fortified guild hall with a blank charcoal banner. Row two left to right: three matching silver armored chess pawns grouped as one team, a dark stone boss altar holding one large ivory monster claw, a square stone labyrinth miniature with open pathways, a small dark steel pedestal supporting three distinct silver theatrical masks for a character drafting mode. No trophy, arena gate, anvil or compass. Each complete object stays strictly within the middle 60 percent of its cell, including all tips and shadows.

红色HP、青色MP与金色XP保持；CURSED徽章由紫色改为红色，但选中标签、勾选框和开启开关仍为金色，没有遵循青色选择语义。
新增分页、删除昨天的输入框与步进器；显示值与角色名称改变，这些属于同提示词下的自由布局和内容差异。

observations: 两版均为四列两行且八件物品顺序一致；今天斧柄倾向左下，昨天倾向右下，盾面纹样、头盔角度和戒指造型也有变化。
药瓶由金色外框改为颈部绳结与吊牌，水晶簇形状与基座变化；红药、紫戒指、青盾宝石及青水晶仍易区分。
20%安全留白仍未满足，剑尖与盾顶接近上边缘；斧刃最高处略过理论y=512行界，直接等分裁切仍有截边风险。

observations: 四列两行八组图形齐全，顺序为训练假人、远征飞艇、挑战塔、公会厅／三人队伍、首领祭坛、迷宫、选角面具。各组轮廓可辨，没有文字标签。
飞艇船头略越理论x=384列界，迷宫左角也贴近列界；塔顶青色光束接近上边缘，未满足格内中心60%和20%留白要求，使用等分图集前需要裁切校对。
首领祭坛出现红色布饰、队伍出现蓝色围巾，超出约定的克制配色；塔的青色能量表现符合用途。
主体完整，没有明显组间遮挡；飞艇、公会厅和迷宫细节较多，缩成小入口时建筑细部辨识度会降低。
四列两行八组图形齐全，顺序为设置齿轮、邮件、任务册、编队棋盘／图鉴放大镜、签到日历、兑换天平、通知铃。棋盘确有四枚棋子。
各物件完整，没有明显越过等分格界；日历为空白，任务册没有文字。金币与蜡封有装饰纹样，不是纯无纹表面。
多数主体宽度超过单格60%，20%安全留白未达标；底色有柔和阴影，不是严格纯色，适合深色底入口并需按实际轮廓处理。
未出现已有背包、铁砧、沙漏、奖章和地图；齿轮、信封、日历和铃铛的形状相对简单，作为小尺寸入口的主观可读性优于复杂建筑图标。
